title: Identification of a clonal population of Aspergillus flavus by MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry using deep learning
summary: Learned MALDI-TOF spectra distinguished the identified Aspergillus flavus clonal population from other isolates, a specific fungal identification result.

evidence.tested: Learned MALDI-TOF spectra distinguished the identified Aspergillus flavus clonal population from other isolates, a specific fungal identification result.
evidence.unknown: The result is an isolate-level MALDI-TOF identification in the studied set, not a general claim about fungal populations. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies MALDI-TOF mass-spectrometry spectra to distinguish a clonal Aspergillus flavus population from other isolates.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
